name: UN Sustainable Development Goal Report
description: Standard reporting framework for progress against the 2030 Agenda and the 17 Sustainable Development Goals, with emphasis on SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities) and SDG 16 (Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions).
key_sections: Intersecting Issues and Leave No One Behind
key_requirements: Baseline data with year of measurement
Progress indicators mapped to official SDG indicator framework
Disaggregated data by gender, age, disability, ethnicity
Identification of most vulnerable and marginalized groups
Reference period and next reporting cycle stated
